title: Wonderful tour, and the information provided after was very helpful.
text: This tour is a wonderful start to a beautiful time in Barcelona.  It helps give you to information needed to explore on your own later.  Lucy is amazing and so very kind and knowledgeable.
author: Teresa_D

title: Gothic Quarter with a fabulous guide
text: I can’t give enough praise for our guide, Lucy. She provided very thorough information about what we were seeing and delivered it with charm and a friendly smile. My wife especially appreciated Lucy walking us through the market and pointing out products unique to Catalonia as well as her favorite vendors for each. Lucy was on a first name basis with many of them and was clearly popular. We received very good service as a result. She also gave us a recommendation for lunch at a local’s restaurant and walked us to the restaurant and introduced us to the owner. The food was outstanding.
author: John_H

title: Enrique was an excellent...
text: Enrique was an excellent guide, providing great background and history throughout  the tour.  Lots of highlights and adequate stops for pictures.
author: Luther_L

title: DON'T MISS THIS PLACE.
text:
Old Town in Barcelona is a romantic and picturesque area that you rarely meet elsewhere. We took pictures all the time forman sees something new picturesque every time you turn around. Great. Barcelona overthrew my heart and will remain so forever. 
In ❤️ Barcelona.
author: Melanie S

title: Excellent and informative
text: Our guide was very informative and knowledgeable and he took us to places we would never have seen.  He was excellent and I would recommend him to anyone coming and planning a tour.
author: Arthur C

title: Setting the old areas of Barcelona and learning about its history was very interesting.
text: This was a 5 star rating. Marlon was a great guide providing interesting detail with a bit of humor. It was interesting to learn about the centuries of conflict in this beatify city that now has such a fun vibe to it!
author: Linda G

title: Great tour!
text: Enrique was an outstanding tour guide! Very informative and personable! We highly recommend him and this tour!
author: Janis_G

title: Fabulous tour and guide
text: Our tour guide, Enrique was wonderful. We walked (in the rain) for  a 3 1/2 hour tour thru the streets of the city. We were the entire tour so it was very private and we felt like we were seeing a very unique glimpse of the city. There was so much history and Enrique had so many stories to share. Because of the rain, we did not have the crowds so were able to spend time in different areas. Loved it all.
author: Sue_F

title: Great tour!
text: Our knowledgeable guide took us to so many great places in the city.  He was very engaging and the tour was well paced.
author: Alexander_W

title: Excellent Old Town tour
text: Excellent tour. Hit all important places of Old Town. Our guide Lucy was knowledgeable, informative, easy going and very aware of 98 F heat - always choose shady areas for stops
